strata.label: Non-Dex system
strata.description: Participants whose repeated job is not primarily served by Dex.

strata.label: Dex or customized system
strata.description: Participants using Dex or a materially customized personal system.

exclusions: high-impact job where the declared observable signal cannot be measured safely

evidence_consent.trigger: before any participant system is touched

actions: verify receipts, caches, and browser data
exit_criteria: deletion is verified or escalated as an incident

adverse_event_reporting.trigger: privacy, consent, ownership, recovery, or control failure

incident_response.trigger: simulated Recovery failed or observed severe failure

participant_evidence: absent: this protocol file contains no observed participant evidence
independent_signoff: absent: legal/ethics and independent gate signoff remain external decisions
